headline: TBR @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.00 at LAD 4.91, with a projected total of 8.90. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (TBR +0.50, LAD +0.45), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.97, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shohei Ohtani has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Freddie Freeman, Shohei Ohtani, Jonathan Aranda, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Alex Freeland, Chandler Simpson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
